frontier_selector.why: The presence of a mixed sclerotic and lytic lesion in the T12 vertebral body, CT-guided biopsy demonstrating a malignant neoplasm composed of spindle cells, and specific immunohistochemical staining patterns decided it.

support_spans: a mixed sclerotic and lytic lesion in the T12 vertebral body
CT-guided biopsy of a pulmonary nodule demonstrated a malignant neoplasm composed of spindle cells
Immunohistochemical staining of the tumor cells was positive for Bcl-2, vimentin, EMA, CD56, CD99, and TLE-1
